_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chiller-multi, variant: chiller_staging_fleet on the over-staged plant's two chillers only (CH1__over_staged, CH2__over_staged), both running whenever the plant does, at the default redundancy ceiling of 0.9. Measured: warn, 44.2 % of the 780 two-chiller samples over-staged, against a capacity of 106.5 kW read from the chillers' own 95th-percentile power (neither ever runs near full load, so that reads low).
